statement: After a display equation the next source line belongs to the same paragraph unless a blank line separates them: a "where ..." or "with ..." continuation stays attached with no blank line; text that starts a new idea (applying or interpreting the equation) follows a blank line. The equation's own spacing is unaffected.
why: The blank line is the paragraph boundary.
provenance: writing-style rules 12, 27; old SKILL.md conventions; user ruling 2026-11-10; self-check; user review 2026-11-23 P4-budget: checked by lint

statement: Define every symbol of an equation before it or immediately after it ("where ..."); punctuate equations as parts of the sentence.
why: An undefined symbol stops the reader.
